cues: The mistakes the examiner looks for.
I must have to go: one obligation word only.
We should to respect: no to after should.
You had better to consult: had better takes the bare infinitive.
Yesterday I must submit: must has no past, so had to.
May be he is at home: the adverb is maybe, one word.
And he mustn't worry, there's no hurry: that means forbidden; you need needn't.
